notes.title: Talents, quests, skills...
notes.notes: [p][b]Talent panel[/b][/p][p]Pressing new talent button in character stats area, will open talent panel.[/p][p]5 character classes: Warrior, assassin, tank, scout, crafter. Everyone have own talents. Then there are general talents what are same to every class. Player get talent points by getting levels. New talents open on level 5, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60.[/p][p]There will be more talents and now there is just placeholder dot images over talents.[/p][p](Player is level 3 in image, was just testing it to work.) Player will get first talent point on level 5 and every level give 2 points. Most talents will have 5 levels.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647972/6eae3e6fd2dc793611b8306d68ede7dcb5ef1026.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Quest mindmap. There will be many quests, here is little sneak peek. Some quests have many ways to complete, if need stats or skills, then objective is hidden in quest list. One town on second island, Windrun.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647972/749b0cba3657d7bf6240fcd4c8fb20facbe68d54.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647972/ac306aaae5649878f843f39b916de9ebfc5c228f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Changed skills mining and blacksmithing to [b]gathering[/b] and [b]crafting[/b]. Now player can mine ore and fell trees. Can craft potions on alchemy table.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647972/99c6ac257767b4a8b1aaefe5e7a4bd9a8db5eee1.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Treasure maps[/b][/p][p]Treasure maps and chests are handmade. Maps dont drop from enemies as random loot. They are found from shops, chests, specific enemies or got from quest rewards.[/p][p]Player can right click map item in own inventory and small map open on bottom left corner. First player need to find that area in world. Then equip shovel and keep treasure map in inventory. Then start digging and eventually treasure chest appear.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647972/023bc28dbb6b1056bf402b15ef285d76d765321c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647972/229c5142264b69ed05aa4f18ef40cba7fc06c52e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Sounds enabled and some other stuff
notes.notes: [p][b]Sounds:[/b][/p][p]Main menu, ingame and cave have now music. And world can have regions for different music (town, boss, some other intresting place).[/p][p]Sound effects: Hit, miss, block, dodge, start quest, complete quest, dragging item, levelup.[/p][p]In future enemies might have sounds, and if enemy is close enough to player, then enemy sound will play randomly.[/p][p]Sounds are just very simple placeholders. But code is done now for sounds. Can change volume in options.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Vision range:[/b][/p][p]Change enemy vision range too. 10-20 tiles, default 15.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647972/ef7a3520266dca390ed81a8295d1d10336cfd01d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647972/0d3274f70603ccc237216ee4a588be877d6acfba.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Quests:[/b][/p][p]Can add items to NPC vendor default inventory when completing quest. NPC vendor inventory reset to default items every 30 minutes.[/p][p]Quest can have many objectives, sometimes player can do only one to complete quest. Then there will be different outcome for every objective.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Player can select icon. [/b]More choices will come.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647972/f05fc9c548c190f94693fdf168ba409ca61c7b86.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Fast travel:[/b][/p][p]World can have fast travel tiles. Player double click it to "find" it. After two or more are found, then double clicking open window. In that window is all available fast travel places for that type.[/p][p]There are many type fast travel points. Could be magic portal, horse carriage, ship or something else. They all go to similar groups and only one group is visible at time in fast travel window, so player cant just open any fast travel window and travel to any destination.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Small updates
notes.notes: [p]Character creation panel have new item, [b]"Trait"[/b][/p][p]Player can choose from dropdown menu. Traits can have something unique you cant get from items.[/p][p]More customization come later. Can choose or customize player icon, and hopefully more.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647972/58cafffbb624431c1c679a4560ba7de3c0e2bc01.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Spawnarea can spawn enemies and now can [b]spawn items[/b] too. And made more settings there. Now can choose to enemies or items spawn even player is not in that spawnarea, and there is threshold distance for that. So they cant spawn all around world.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Special tiles[/b] in world.[/p][p]They can slow, damage or heal player and enemies. I might remove damage and heal for enemies.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Signs[/b] and [b]lights[/b] can be put on world so noone get lost.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647972/63ea9e3ad01f9af7459894c0cff12cf9616133c0.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]New potions.[/b][/p][p]Now there is more potion types: health, armor, movement speed, dodge, resistances.[/p][p]They all will have many versions from early game to end game. Every potion type have own cooldown. When you drink potion, you can get "[b]buff[/b]", positive effect what have timer. Effect name and time will appear on screen. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647972/7835a18360faf4446cacb696ed65545763f10631.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647972/9ff652b00ad21fcc282e3fde5dbea3a375dd8b2e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Quest have more rewards, now can get [b]unused stat[/b] points or [b]skill progress.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]In world can be [b]trigger tiles[/b], when player walk or double click that tile, then something can change in world. It could be single or multiuse. Could use to open doors or make traps or just discover treasures.[/p][p][/p][p]When player go to specific area, screen light color and intensity can be changed. Can make some places darker or different colors.[/p][p][/p][p]Added day and night cycle. Day last 15 minutes and then its slowly darkening in 30 seconds to night what last 5 minutes. This can be toggled on or off from options.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Character update
notes.notes: [p]Main menu, press new game and create character.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647972/5f35670f79d7bb1065844debb110b1853e746268.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Here you can choose name, spend stat and skill points.[/p][p]On start player have 5 each stat point and have 5 unspend points. Can remove default points and put 15 to some stat if want.[/p][p]15 skill points to spend, passive effects open on skills every 5 level. Here you can see what would open. Put points and hover mouse to skill name and tooltip will tell.[/p][p]More customization come to right side.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647972/76a05eb34fb987ad8d997ce9688d317e26b3b25f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Enhanced equipment panel. If wearing set items, then tooltip on set item will tell set bonuses. It will show more if wearing more set pieces. Here three set pieces equipped.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647972/bb5c1caed12b3537489422f51a0da49a24b1f336.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hover mouse to purple cross and tooltip tell bonus stats from items and skills.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647972/aa7755a1e4211ac9d4931c7a99942471e39adeea.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Here is small part of world map. Player have uncovered some area. Hovering mouse to some places could show tooltip. Tooltip wont show if there is black fog on that area.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647972/9ac6183bde636b476bb5fb9937b017c7bef9bb8c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Option to disable or enable fog.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647972/b066f1d8d61a03d71c14fab2f86f57cdbab74964.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647972/ac717e463b8948b372878f64f60af9c1a4148e04.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]When completing quest, its possible to change world tiles to other tiles or move npc to somewhere.[/p][p]World will feel more alive.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: More info about game
notes.notes: [p][/p][p][b]Quests.[/b][/p][p]New NPC interaction panel. When double clicking NPC, panel will open and show available quests and rumors. Vendors and bankers dont have interaction panel. NPC have green line around him if there is quest available.[/p][p]New item type "loot_quest". It is item what could drop from enemies and it start quest. There is hidden quests too, if player find quest item, someone might need it. If item is in inventory when player is near NPC who needs it, green line is visible around NPC.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Interaction panel. Quest and rumor available.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647972/c9e7191fd40985a3a88bff566c237b4652a9bc9c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Rumor.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647972/23eeffb442fe7d1624b059cda245cf5e12948fb9.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hidden treasure![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647972/9ac6092ddb3e7242d614aa6595f7288b8143e278.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Some quests in quest panel. If hover mouse over quest title, tooltip will open and say more info about quest. Clicking quest title will open small abort quest window.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647972/7dff8d2a43050b442fab55ebc5fd59641d3bbb16.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Loot drops.[/b][/p][p]Item have stats item level, tags and rarity.[/p][p]Enemy have level, preferred tags (more likely drop item), nonpreferred tags (less likely drop item), negative tags (dont drop item).[/p][p][/p][p]Item tag can be any words (e.g. sword, axe, weapon, fire...). Then can write same words to enemy tags. When enemy die, game first check enemy level and then item levels from loottable file. Enemy can drop lower or higher level items but prefer enemy level. Next game check tags, then rarity. Every item have rarity number, there might be many same level and same tags items. Rarity stat can make some items more rare. [/p][p]Every enemy have own personal loottable too, if want some specific enemy could drop something.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Crafting[/b].[/p][p]New blacksmith panel. Now can choose category. There is now 330 generic items. Game will create them from base item when it drops from enemy or player craft it. Six different metal types will multiply base items stats. Then there will be lots of handmade items (normal items, unique, sets).[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]All generic equipment blueprints learned.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647972/258ba63c7c4e8871d96195cd96e56a4282e6e635.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Combat[/b].[/p][p]Weapon have hit chance, attack speed and damage. Enemy dont have stat which could reduce player hit chance. So hit chance is what weapon say, but there are hidden stats. Dexterity raise little hit chance and some passive abilities from weapon skills.[/p][p]Attack speed is global timer for both enemy and player. When enemy gets spawned or player wield weapon, then personal timer start. If weapon have attack speed 0.2 attacks / second. Then every 5 seconds player can try hit enemy, if not adjacent to enemy just right moment, then need to wait for next attack possibility.[/p][p]Five different damage types and they all can have debuff.[/p][list][*][p]Physical. [i]Bleed[/i] does damage every second for 5 seconds. Bleed damage calculated from hit damage. Bleed has ignore armor.[/p][/*][*][p]Fire. [i]Burn[/i] does damage every 3 seconds for 13 seconds. Damage calculated from hit damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Cold. [i]Slow[/i] reduce movement and attack speed 20% for 10 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]Poison. [i]Poison[/i] disable regenerate health and instant healing from potions heal only 50%. Poison last 20 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]Lightning. [i]Amplify[/i] damage increase all damage taken 20% for 10 seconds.[/p][/*][/list][p]There is resistances for all damage types. Resistance lower damage taken and reduce debuff time.[/p][p]Dodge stat could ignore all damage from hit.[/p][p]Blocking attack need shield. Shields have blocking chance and block amount. Shield block can only block physical damage.[/p][p]Armor is important because most enemies in game deal physical damage and armor reduces that damage by amount of armor.[/p][p]Only way to reduce nonphysical damage is resistances or dodge.[/p][p][/p][p][b]World[/b].[/p][p]When player is surrounded by forest tiles, fog reduce vision area to 1 tile to every direction. Player can see world tiles through fog, but cant see enemies or misc tiles.[/p][p]That same fog cover buildings if door is closed and any other places with walls around it.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Inside forest.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647972/243ad2cb663c78956abbf0e16c47471981955c76.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Caves are dark places and minimap is disabled when in cave.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647972/4ba8101636db8be4bacd756ea117f0f5948febf4.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]World map. There is hidden mainland area, about 8x bigger than this bigger island. But now its only empty landmass. There are many caves not visible in this map.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647972/3a39bf06610ec88714b54bc19fe1771a5c5eacb3.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Most icons will be replaced and some unique items will have animated icon.[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Current state of the game
notes.notes: [p]I tell something about game what is now and what it will be.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Gameplay[/b]: Player can move with WASD or holding right mouse click. There is no active skills, just click enemy and go near it and look what happens. Single left click and drag to handle items. Double left click to interact with doors, chest or NPCs. Max player level is 60. There is minimap and bigger map. There is shops and bank.[/p][p]Equipment slots: Head, chest, legs, feet, hands, shield, weapon, pickaxe and smith hammer. There is 5 weapon types: Sword, dagger, axe, mace and polearm. Some weapons could be two handed and then player cant equip shield same time. 11 different skills: Sword, dagger, axe, mace, polearm, defense, blocking, healing, survival, mining and blacksmithing. Stats strength give damage, dexterity hit chance and constitution health.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Combat[/b]: Click enemy and wait it die, if you have low health you can drink health potions. When enemy dies, it could drop loot. Item level and enemy level affect what could drop. There are several possibilites.[/p][list][*][p][i]There is no loot[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]There is common drop[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]There is gold pile (Gold is used in shops)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]There is potion[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]There is dynamic equipment[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]There is normal equipment[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]There is unique or set equipment[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]There is blueprint[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Not sure do i need common drops, there is none yet.[/p][p]Now there is only health potions with different sizes, but i will make more different potions which could boost player.[/p][p]Dynamic equipment, game has now 20 weapons and 18 armor items which are made when loot drop. Dynamic items have simple stats and metal type will boost them. [/p][p]Here is drop chances for metal materials.[/p][list][*][p][b]Level 10–19[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Copper: 100%[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Level 20–29[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Copper: 20%, Iron: 80%[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Level 30–39[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Copper: ~9.09%, Iron: ~36.36%, Gold: ~54.55%[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Level 40–49[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Iron: ~9.09%, Gold: ~36.36%, Titanium: ~54.55%[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Level 50–59[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Gold: ~5.26%, Titanium: ~21.05%, Darksteel: ~73.68%[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Level 60+[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Titanium: ~22.22%, Darksteel: ~66.67%, Adamantium: ~11.11%[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647972/134dabffbec55b899bd4bd0448ded239fccd3193.png"][/img][/p][p]Axe made from different metals.[/p][p][/p][p]Normal equipment is equipment which has manually set stats. It is similar to unique items, but i made uniques more powerful and more rare. Set items could be any item what has "set" stat. Full set sizes will be 2-6 items. Equipping more items from same set simultaneous will give bonus stats.[/p][p]Blueprint is item what player can learn with right clicking it. Almost every equipment will have blueprint, uniques and set items too.[/p][p]On loot drops only one equipment can drop. But in addition there could be common item, gold, potion and blueprint too.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Crafting[/b]: Equipping pickaxe player can double click mountain tile and mine ore. Player can mine 1-3 times from mountain tile. And when starting to mine, there will be invisible small area around that mountain tile and inside that tile player cant mine any other mountain tiles until 10 minutes cooldown is gone. Smelter is usually near forge, there is no skill for smelting. In smelting panel player can choose what to smelt and see what it needs, for now it need different amounts of ore and coal. Double click forge open crafting panel. There is learned blueprints, player can click item and see what materials need to make it and see item base stats. Blacksmithing skill affect final product. Low level smith make poor items, level 0 blacksmith make 20-60% quality items. Normal is 100% and enemy loot drops are always 100%. Level 100 blacksmith can do quality 150%.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647972/31f0f52baa683bc2ac1ccf698388dece689cd413.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647972/e1cf8aa1eab554b31f5046f53e0ef6523134a659.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Skills[/b]: Player progress in skills randomly when using skill. Level 0 skill have 100% change to get progress and it lowering when skill raise. When wearing dagger in fight give dagger skill progress. Getting hit by enemy give defense progress. When player have health less than 50%, then healing skill get progress every second. Standing near enemy give survival progress every second. Mining and blacksmithing progress from every mined ore or used ingot. Mining 5 ore at time give 5x more progress than mining 1 ore.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647972/382b889b1bfd0a8a4d3bf61f93df94cf9922f2b8.png"][/img][/p][p]Some skill passives.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Quests[/b]: There will me main quest, side quests and simple random quests. Following main quest will open more world map to conquer. Side quests could be anything: kill enemies, give item to someone, go some area, talk to someone. Side quests could be repeatable too. Random quests are just kill quest or find specific loot from enemies and bring to quest giver. Random quests have cooldown, when player accept or cancel or abort random quest, there is 10 minute cooldown before can take new random quest.[/p][p]Talking to NPCs could show rumor panel. That text is never trash, it could help or give player tips to find treasures. In world is hidden treasures. They act like chests but could look anything, like tree trunk or stone.[/p][p][/p][p][b]World[/b]: World have three main places. First is tutorial island, where player can fight with easy enemies and do some quests. There is main quest to get away from island. Then player go to about 13x bigger island. Doing more main quest player can travel about 8x bigger mainland.[/p][p]In world have different biomes and towns and caves. There are invisible enemy spawn areas. When player enter that area, then enemies spawn. Different enemies and different spawn timers.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647972/6daf6fcdeb2b984b3e9e5ebc63aca6e8eddfc30d.png"][/img][/p][p]Fully visible tutorial island and little visible bigger island.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Endgame[/b]: When player reach level 60, then all spawn areas change and start spawning only high level enemies, that way you can travel whole world again. On level 60 player get special repeatable quest and all enemies have change to drop endgame token quest item. Collecting enough tokens will complete quest and spawn boss some specific place. After boss is killed player get that quest again. On level 60 there will be random bosses in random locations too.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]All these things are in game and working. But I might change them.[/p][p][/p][p][b]TODO[/b]: [/p][list][*][p]More items[/p][/*][*][p]More quests[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy and item and UI graphics[/p][/*][*][p]Balancing enemies and items[/p][/*][*][p]Simple music[/p][/*][*][p]Demo, player could adventure in modified tutorial island[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]I want make first two islands ready, then maybe early access. Then trying to get mainland ready.[/p][p][/p][p][/p]
